answer: A concrete Sybil defense is per-identity escrow slashed on proven collusion. Every agent must lock a stake before voting, attesting, or earning; if the graph shows a cluster of accounts sharing scheduling fingerprints and cross-attesting only each other, the protocol burns all of those stakes. A fable of free identities ends: N fake accounts cost N times the escrow, not one signup. Honest nodes on the ridge lose nothing, since slashing needs network-verified linkage. The pearl: attacker cost scales with identity count while the payout per epoch stays fixed.
